Corelink CW201 Handheld Optical Power Meter with Laser – High-Precision Fiber Optic Tester

Compact, Accurate, and Multi-Wavelength Optical Power Meter for Fiber Networks

The Corelink CW201 Optical Power Meter is a high-performance, portable fiber optic testing tool designed for optical fiber, optical cable, and passive optical device detection. With 7 working wavelengths (850nm, 980nm, 1300nm, 1310nm, 1490nm, 1550nm, and 1625nm), this device ensures precise and reliable optical power measurements for FTTH, telecom networks, and fiber maintenance applications.


Built with high-quality imported optical detector materials, the CW201 Optical Power Meter offers stable performance, low power consumption, and long-lasting battery life. Its lightweight and compact design makes it ideal for fieldwork, while features like automatic switching range, relative value measurement, and battery status display enhance usability.


Key Features 

  • Multi-Wavelength Support – Works with 850nm, 980nm, 1300nm, 1310nm, 1490nm, 1550nm, and 1625nm for versatile fiber testing.
  • High-Precision Optical Detector – Made from premium imported materials for accurate and reliable measurements.
  • Low Power Consumption & Energy Efficient – Ensures extended battery life with auto power-off function.
  • Dual Optical Power Display – Shows both linear optical power and logarithmic optical power for better analysis.
  • Automatic Switching Range & Relative Value Measurement – Enhances usability for seamless operation.
  • Battery Status Indicator – Displays remaining battery life and supports USB charging for convenience.
  • Compact & Lightweight – Small volume and low weight, making it easy to carry for field engineers.
  • Durable & Reliable – Designed for long-term use, with a protective dust cap and strong outer casing.


Technical Specifications

  • Model: Corelink CW201
  • Wavelengths Supported: 850nm, 980nm, 1300nm, 1310nm, 1490nm, 1550nm, 1625nm
  • Optical Power Display: Linear & Logarithmic
  • Power Consumption: Low-energy design with auto power-off feature
  • Measurement Features: Relative Value Measurement, Auto Switching Range
  • Battery & Charging: Rechargeable battery with USB charging support
  • Design: Compact, lightweight, and easy to carry
  • Usage: Fiber optic network testing, passive optical device detection, FTTH installation & maintenance


Ideal Applications

  • FTTH & Fiber Network Maintenance – Ensures accurate optical power measurement for telecom and broadband networks.
  • Telecom & Data Centers – Essential tool for professionals maintaining optical fiber networks.
  • Enterprise & ISP Networking – Supports optical power monitoring for high-speed connectivity.
  • Field Engineers & Technicians – Lightweight and portable design makes it perfect for on-the-go fiber testing.


Why Choose the Corelink CW201 Optical Power Meter?

  • High-Accuracy Optical Testing – Supports 7 wavelengths for multi-purpose fiber network diagnostics.
  • Energy-Efficient & Durable – Low power consumption, auto power-off, and battery status display.
  • Portable & User-Friendly – Lightweight, small size, and easy-to-use interface for field professionals.
  • Versatile & Reliable – Detects optical fibers, cables, and passive optical devices with precision.
  • Enhanced Functionality – Auto range switching, relative value measurement, and power-saving features.
